partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Explicit inhibitory pharmacology for GOF driver
results.hypothesis: Explicit inhibition, antagonism, channel block, or negative modulation of a GOF disease driver is more reliable than an untyped decreased effect.
results.body: drug binds GOF driver; activity decrease carries an explicit negative pharmacologic mechanism
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule aligns a curated GOF disease mechanism with explicit pharmacologic semantics rather than relying only on an effect-direction string.
results.trapi_notes: Binding, activity effect, mechanism qualifier, and variant-qualified disease association are TRAPI-expressible; ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect.causal_mechanism_qualifier IN ['inhibition', 'antagonism', 'molecular_channel_blockage', 'antibody_inhibition', 'inverse_agonism', 'negative_modulation', 'negative_allosteric_modulation', 'gating_inhibition', 'competitive_inhibition', 'antisense_oligonucleotide_inhibition']
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
